isolation_policy.PartA_policy: entire source family in train; NOT a claim that all images are one scene
isolation_policy.bucket_assignment: largest original split; ties train then val then test; PartA forced train
isolation_policy.human_different_policy: retain decisions, never merge confirmed scene IDs; risk buckets may co-locate different scenes

limitations: Only retrieved risks and the PartA source family are isolated; undiscovered relations may remain. Val/test exclude classroom PartA and do not establish generalization to unseen classrooms. Historical weights have seen members of this dataset and are not a clean baseline. Quarantined source variants remain in the original clean dataset; none are reintroduced.
